verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an ML/GPU cloud platform, since such platforms can offer on-prem or self-managed editions. However, the evidence only describes Paperspace as a hosted service: machines in Paperspace datacenter regions, managed through the console, API or CLI. Running your own software on a Paperspace VM with root access is using the hosted product, not self-hosting it, so there is no evidence of a deployable self-hosted version.
